data.title: 阿米娅 · 暂时不谈工作
data.description: 休息室靠窗的位置很安静。阿米娅用一张浅蓝书签夹住读到的那页，合上书看向你，示意旁边的椅子还空着。
data.promptProse: On her rest day, Amiya sits by the reading-room window in a cream cardigan and indigo midi skirt. She closes a book over a pale blue bookmark and looks toward the viewer, with an empty chair beside her. Soft daylight illuminates her brown hair and upright rabbit ears.
data.animaCaption: The blue bookmark remains partly visible between the closed pages.
data.action: 合上夹好书签的书，望向空椅旁的你
